nine_b_native_repair.fixture: Fresh disposable copy of the failed ff69 Task12 UI source; only web/app.js could be edited; native Agent with local Qwen3.5-9B-6bit, installed guarded 96K profile and browser/search tools ready.
nine_b_native_repair.outcome: FAIL: the driver timed out after 368.169 seconds and 35 tool calls. The model edited only web/app.js, but tried the browser before a server was live, then started the server in a foreground shell that timed out. No resource guard abort occurred.
nine_b_native_repair.independent_checks: Backend unittest 2/2, node --check and git diff --check passed. Independent Task12 browser check passed literal inert stored markup, invalid input, real POST 503/manual retry, and 390/1280 reload checks, then failed the duplicate new-ID POST/conflict check. The model used a set of loaded IDs to choose PATCH instead of explicit Edit state. An earlier browser Edit click produced a page error before the final renderEntries edit; the final Edit path and later browser assertions were not reached by the independent check and remain unverified.
nine_b_native_repair.decision: Not a coding/UI pass. Do not turn the six early browser passes into full acceptance. After repeated 9B repairs, change approach rather than adding prompt rules.
